title: MGX joins OpenAI's $6.6B round

sources.quote: The latest funding round also included participation from Khosla Ventures, Altimeter Capital, Fidelity, MGX and Tiger Global, sources told CNBC.

explain: Abu Dhabi's MGX reportedly took part in OpenAI's $6.6 billion October 2024 round (counted in full on the Thrive record); its amount was not disclosed.
